scope.purpose: Strong Asset Fine-Tuningの候補をdeck+agent pair単位で棚卸し

identity_and_inference_rules: 性能identityは(agent policy SHA, deck SHA)のpair。同一deckでもpolicy別agentを統合しない。
declared canonical deck SHAとdeck.csv raw SHAを別フィールドで保存。
archetypeはSOURCE/ID/deck名の明示ヒントだけで推定。meta/medal generic agentはdecklist-only。
strengthは既存artifact/SOURCEの明示値のみ。実行中arenaの未完了出力は除外。

global_best_known.basis: 既存明示96局fixed-six pair strength最大

external_lb_alternative.caveat: benchは0.05秒探索予算で提出版1.0秒より弱い。common arena勝率ではない。

provisional_best_known.not_yet_claimed: Stage1 arena完了・manifest検証後までcommon-pool GlobalBestKnownは未確定

archetype_best_known_provisional.caveat: R7 smoke false。tomatomatoとは同一deckでも別agent/policy。

current_source_broad_snapshot.interpretation: 親agentから完了報告されたcurrent-source broad 96局の値。ただしCensus agentは実行中arenaの出力を読まず、完了報告のwins/faultだけを別証拠欄へ転記した。これらをprovisional GlobalBestKnownやStrong Asset pair順位へ統合していない。最終manifest、W/D/L、seat/seed/opponent内訳、protocol/SHA整合は別reconciliationで確認する。

limitations_and_next_actions: R7 is measured strongest but smoke false/local_eval_only; do not train/promote/submit.
waterbox LB789.4 is external submitted version; local bench 0.05 sec is weaker than submitted 1.0 sec.
tomatomato/R7 and other shared decks remain separate agent+deck pairs.
Current Stage1 arena is excluded until complete; then rerun read-only reconciliation.
training_usable=yes only tomatomato/lucifer bounded local teacher collection.
Different pool/seat/seed/game counts must not be directly ranked.
